meta.title: HSK 2 — English to Chinese
meta.subtitle: 151 words · recall the characters and pinyin
meta.desc: Shown an English meaning, recall the simplified form, the traditional form and the pinyin. All 151 words of the official HSK 2 vocabulary list (HSK 2.0, the 2012 syllabus). Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the syllabus's own definition — the sense the exam means, rather than every sense the word has. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 93 of the 151 words. Each card also breaks the word into its characters, giving each one's reading, its meaning and the radical it is filed under, and carries a fold of three real example sentences, chosen to put the word in three different sentence shapes rather than the same one three times, with the word picked out in colour in each. Word list and definitions: the official HSK 2012 Level 2 syllabus. Traditional forms, bopomofo and measure words: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0). Radicals and character meanings: Make Me a Hanzi. Example sentences: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), CC BY 2.0 FR.
